name: mp_shoot_dropped_grenades
description: When enabled (1), shooting a dropped grenade on the ground activates/detonates it. Requires sv_cheats 1. Disabled (0) by default.

name: cl_crosshairstyle
description: Crosshair style. 0 = Dynamic Cross, 1 = Dynamic Circle, 2 = Dynamic Cross (Classic), 3 = Static Circle, 4 = Static Cross, 5 = Dynamic Cross (Legacy / Shot Feedback), 6 = Dot Only, 7 = Dynamic Quad. Styles 0, 1 and 7 track the weapon's actual inaccuracy.

name: cl_crosshair_length
description: Length of each crosshair bar, scaled with screen resolution

name: cl_crosshair_gap
description: Offset added to the gap between the crosshair center and the bars.

name: cl_crosshair_thickness
description: Thickness of the crosshair bars and circle, scaled with screen resolution (minimum 1 pixel)

name: cl_crosshaircolor_a
description: Crosshair opacity. 0 = fully transparent, 255 = fully opaque

name: cl_crosshair_dynamic_spread_limit
description: The additional distance the dynamic elements are allowed to spread out to from the baseline of 128 pixels.

name: cl_crosshair_dynamic_splitdist
description: Style 2: distance at which the crosshair bars split in two.

name: cl_crosshair_dynamic_splitalpha_innermod
description: Style 2 only: alpha multiplier for the INNER crosshair bars once they have split. [0 - 1]

name: cl_crosshair_dynamic_splitalpha_outermod
description: Style 2 only: alpha multiplier for the OUTER crosshair bars once they have split. [0.3 - 1]

name: cl_crosshair_dynamic_maxdist_splitratio
description: Style 2 only: how the bar length is divided between inner and outer bars once split. inner = length * (1 - ratio), outer = length * ratio. [0 - 1]

name: cl_crosshair_drawoutline
description: Draw a black outline around the crosshair for better visibility

name: cl_crosshair_recoil
description: Crosshair follows the weapon's predicted recoil (aim punch)

name: cl_crosshairdot
description: Draw a dot at the center of the crosshair

name: cl_sniper_delay_unscope
description: Delay unscope so the scope view lingers briefly (cannot fire until fully unscoped).
